discussion_comments.comment_body: **should-fix — both tests pass without testing anything.** `clone_first_worktree_rejects_destination_inside_source` asserts only when `clone_works_on`. Even then it expects `result.is_err()`, but `worktree_add` swallows clone errors and falls back to a plain checkout, so the assertion can't hold on a reflink-capable FS. `clone_first_worktree_removes_nested_git_files` asserts only `if result.cloned_with.is_some()`. Because of the root-`.git` deletion above, `cloned_with` is always `None`, so the test passes while the clone path is broken. Assert `cloned_with.is_some()` (behind the `clone_works_on` gate, like the existing clone tests do) so a fallback fails the test. Also note the PR body says these tests were never run.

Fixed in c709e8ea3a: the clone tests now assert `result.cloned_with.is_some()` behind a filesystem-level `clone_works_on()` gate, so a clone path that silently falls back to a plain checkout fails the test instead of passing it.
Fixed in c709e8ea3a: the cleanup test now asserts the clone actually ran (`cloned_with.is_some()`) behind a filesystem-level gate, so the cleanup path is not skipped precisely when it is broken.

Fixed in `70afaaaa60` — the reset now removes the untracked files the copy carried.

`reset_detached_submodule()` (`crates/pi-vcs/src/git/mutate.rs:2223`) cleans the submodule after it checks the pinned commit out. The gix path calls `repo.clean(&CleanOptions::default())`; the reftable path — where gitoxide cannot read the repository — runs `git clean -fd` through `run_sync_write`, because `git checkout` replaces the tracked files only and never removes an untracked one. `CleanOptions::default()` keeps ignored files, so only the untracked content the copy brought along goes, and the submodule's own metadata is untouched: the clean skips a repository entry (`mutate.rs:527`), so the detached submodule's `.git` is never treated as deletable content.

Regression test `remove_nested_git_files_cleans_the_untracked_files_a_copied_submodule_carried` (`crates/pi-vcs/src/git/mutate.rs:4091`) covers it: an untracked `stray.bin` in the source's submodule must not survive the reset, `git status --porcelain` inside the submodule must be empty, the submodule's `.git` must survive, and its HEAD must still match the origin. RED without the fix (removing only the two clean calls fails at the `stray.bin` assertion), GREEN with it.

At the current head `70afaaaa60` the crate suite is green (the branch owner's `cargo nextest run -p pi-vcs`: 119 passed, 0 failed; `cargo clippy -p pi-vcs --all-targets` and `rustfmt --check` clean).
